text:
sara_harrison: Quick announcement — we're starting a 90-day wind-down of the current Starter free-credit slab. This is a planned change to improve cost predictability and reduce edge-case abuse. Details and next steps below. :loudspeaker:

matt_lee: Short version: replace indefinite free slab with a deterministic onboarding bundle (7-day trial + one-time $50 credit for new signups). Enterprise customers and committed Dedicated seats unaffected.

anna_finance: Finance notes: effective billing cutover date = 2026-06-01 (90 days from today). For customers mid-cycle we'll prorate unused credits and issue a single invoice credit line. No retroactive billing.

ops-bot: [Automated] New internal doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/free-slab-phaseout (ops-only) 

jessica_support: Support playbook draft: short response templates, escalations, and refund flow. Key line to use: "Your existing credits will be honored or prorated; new free bundle is simpler and time-bound." Will drop the playbook into #help by EOD.

marco_marketing: Comms plan: 1) Customer email + in-console banner on 2026-05-15; 2) Blog post explaining why (predictability + fairness) on 2026-05-20; 3) FAQ and support snippets live same day. We'll coordinate with legal for wording.

olga_engineering: Two infra items: (1) enforce new rate-smoothing config for newly created free trial accounts, (2) ensure billing metering reports include a new column "legacy_free_slab_prorated" for export. Sample config we plan to push to staging: 

```
# new free-trial smoothing
free_trial: {
  burst_tokens: 2000,
  sustained_rpm: 1200,   # tokens/minute per account
  smoothing_window_secs: 60
}
```

sara_harrison: FAQ guidance for sales: emphasize Dedicated/reserved customers unaffected and that enterprise deals keep negotiated credits. Sales outreach: targeted message to top 100 free-slab users with >$2k/mo estimated spend. @matt_lee to own list.

matt_lee: I'll export the list and share with AE leads by tomorrow. Also tagging @jessica_support to prep common objection scripts for exec review.

anna_finance: Billing team tasking: create a CSV of affected accounts, prorated credit amounts, and invoice-credit entries. ETA 2026-05-10. We'll run a dry-run on May 17.

jessica_support: Draft objection script: "We understand the change; to make migration smoother we're providing a one-time $50 self-serve credit and clear runbook for upgrades. For larger accounts we'll offer account review calls." Sending draft now.

marco_marketing: Need a short banner copy suggestion: "Free tier update: simplifying new accounts — existing credits honored. Learn more →" Thoughts?

olga_engineering: Ops note: We'll add a telemetry flag so we can filter errors caused by the new smoothing on day-1. Tagging eng-oncall for rollout window.

sara_harrison: Action items recap: 
- @matt_lee export top-100 affected list (due TOM)
- @anna_finance CSV/proration run (due 2026-05-10)
- @jessica_support publish playbook (EOD)
- @marco_marketing customer email + banner copy (first draft 2026-05-03)
- @olga_engineering push staging config + telemetry (staging by 2026-05-05)

sara_harrison: Thanks everyone. This change is meant to make billing clearer and protect capacity. If you have any legal/regulatory concerns ping me + legal. :white_check_mark:
